name: Ricardo Flores
bio:
Ricardo's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood in Mexico City, fueled by attending local races and idolizing legendary drivers. He started his career in advertising, quickly rising through the ranks due to his innovative campaigns and dedication to understanding consumer behavior. Ricardo transitioned to motorsport marketing a decade ago, bringing a fresh perspective to team branding and fan engagement.

At Manthey EMA, Ricardo excels in developing creative marketing strategies that resonate with diverse audiences. He is known for his data-driven approach, constantly analyzing market trends to optimize campaigns and enhance brand visibility. Ricardo's ability to blend traditional marketing principles with modern digital techniques makes him a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering commitment to delivering exceptional results. He thrives under pressure and consistently seeks innovative solutions to overcome challenges. His colleagues admire his infectious enthusiasm and collaborative spirit, making him a true team player.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a warm, engaging smile.
